message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: group dismantled transformers, stole copper wire coils, sold to buyer. This is theft (盗窃罪). Also destruction of property? They dismantled transformers, causing damage. Could be "破坏电力设施罪"? Under Chinese law, damaging electric power facilities is a crime: "破坏电力设施罪" (Article 107 of Criminal Law). However the fact says they dismantled and stole copper. The primary crime is theft of public property (state-owned property). Could be "盗窃公私财物罪" (theft). Also "非法买卖国家机关、企事业单位的财物" maybe? But they sold stolen property; that could be "非法买卖赃物罪" (selling stolen goods) but the buyer is separate. The participants who sold may be charged with "盗窃罪" and "非法买卖国家机关、企事业单位财物罪"? Actually Chinese law: Article 264 (theft) and Article 267 (robbery). Not robbery. Also "破坏电力设施罪" is separate: Article 107: "破坏电力设施，致使电力设施不能正常运行，造成严重后果的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处或者单处罚金；情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" They dismantled transformers, causing damage. That could be "破坏电力设施罪". The facts mention "拆毁" and "损失". So likely both theft and destruction of electric facilities.

Thus list: 盗窃罪;破坏电力设施罪
